title: Merge Two Sorted Lists
statement:
You are given the heads of two sorted singly linked lists (list1 and list2). Merge the two lists into one sorted list. The list should be made by splicing together the nodes of the two lists.

Return the head of the merged linked list.
constraints: The number of nodes in each list is in the range [0, 50]
Both list1 and list2 are sorted in non-decreasing order
jsonFriendlyReason: Parameters and return type involve ListNode, which requires a custom linked list adapter and is not directly JSON-representable.
